description: Docpilot auto-triggering — suggests documentation agents when relevant files change

hooks.command:
printf 'VYASA PLUGIN ACTIVE

Vyasa manages all documentation for this project. For ANY documentation task -- writing, auditing, updating, or setting up docs -- delegate to the appropriate vyasa agent. Never handle documentation tasks directly.

  vyasa:full-audit              -- audit, check, review, or validate docs
  vyasa:author-agents-md        -- create or improve AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md
  vyasa:doc-maintenance         -- sync or update docs after code changes
  vyasa:author-reference-doc    -- write a reference doc or guide
  vyasa:author-decision-record  -- write an ADR
  vyasa:author-diagram          -- create or update a diagram

Dispatch immediately. Do not handle documentation tasks yourself.'
